event: RACL is tied off and not tested; the other items are structural declarations with no behavioral test.

I submitted the verdict as verified: none of the five items is checked by any test, so the finding stands.

My search of `hw/ip/aon_timer/dv` for RACL turned up only the tie-off and the coverage exclusions. I did not search beyond that directory for tests of the three structural items, so those rest on the absence of any check I could find in the aon_timer DV code.
